items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: My mother's maiden name was, her maiden name was Frazier, Jeanette Frazier.

ctx.x: How is that family related now? If you can explain a little bit. Well, yes Bill.

The Frazier's too. Yeah, I can explain you that. Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes' mother and my mother, two sisters. What was your mother's maiden name then? My mother's maiden name was, her maiden name was Frazier, Jeanette Frazier. Now, uh, the Frazier's, Josiah Frazier's name, their father and my mother were citizen brothers. Yeah, I see. Yeah.
